verdict.rationale: UKVI's own Innovator Founder page says "You must apply online," with separate flows for applying inside and outside the UK. The processing-times page adds that applicants can verify identity and submit documents and the application online via the UK Immigration: ID Check app, so the core founder visa transaction is documented as completed online. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that the fee is paid online within the same flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end online journey.
